Giannis Kaimenakis | chrtitle = President | chairman = Georgios Borovilos | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = Georgios Antonopoulos | league = [[Super League Greece]] | season = [[2025–26 Super League Greece|2025–26]] | position = [[Super League Greece]], 11th of 14 | pattern_la1 = _asteras2627h | pattern_b1 = _asteras2627h | pattern_ra1 = _asteras2627h | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | shorts1 = FFFF00 | socks1 = FFFF00 | pattern_la2 = _asteras2627a | pattern_b2 = _asteras2627a | pattern_ra2 = _asteras2627a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 0000FF | body2 = 0000FF | rightarm2 = 0000FF | shorts2 = 0000FF | socks2 = 0000FF | website = {{URL|http://www.asterastripolis.gr/|asterastripolis.gr}} | current = 2025–26 Asteras Tripolis F.C. season }} '''Asteras Tripolis Football Club''' ({{langx|el|ΠΑΕ Αστέρας Τρίπολης}}), currently known as '''Asteras AKTOR''' for sponsorship reasons, commonly referred to as '''Asteras''', is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Tripoli, Greece|Tripoli]] in [[Arcadia (regional unit)|Arcadia]], [[Peloponnese]], [[Greece]]. Asteras Tripolis has been competing in [[Super League Greece]], the [[Greek football league system|Greek top professional league]], since the [[2007–08 Super League Greece|2007–08 season]]. They were runners-up of the [[Greek Football Cup]] in [[2012–13 Greek Football Cup|2013]] and have reached the semi-finals of the competition overall four times. Asteras Tripolis has competed in the [[UEFA Europa League]] group stage for two seasons and has a total of five seasons in the competition. The club ranks 10th among the 19 [[Greek football clubs in European competitions|Greek clubs]] with contribution of points for the [[UEFA coefficient|UEFA country ranking]]."}}
